description: Implementation of ContentDao for accessing content data from the database, providing methods for listing, retrieving, and querying Content and ContentDescription entities based on various criteria.

classes.name: ContentDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation for Content entity, providing database access methods for Content and ContentDescription objects.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists Content objects filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and optionally Language, ordered by sortOrder.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Returns list of ContentDescription (name and URL) for Content objects filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its code and MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its ID and Language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its code, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a ContentDescription by its URL and MerchantStore.
